_comment: Ollama pipeline config. Start server: MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=3000 MCP_BEARER_TOKEN=your-secret node dist/index.js
system_prompt_snippet: You have access to an MCP server with 7 Design System tools. When the user asks you to build a page, ALWAYS call build_page with their exact words. When code has color issues, call validate_code to auto-fix it. Use get_cheatsheet at the start of any new component. Tools: build_page, validate_code, get_component, get_pattern, get_tokens, search_ds, get_cheatsheet.
